components.name: Spectral Analyzer
components.description: Performs Fourier-like spectral analysis on audio signals, decomposing them into frequency components across time
capabilities: Read WAV files (44.1kHz, 48kHz, mono/stereo, 16/24-bit)
Decompose audio into frequency-time-intensity matrix
Generate sine/cosine coefficients for musical notes
Support microtonal resolution (subdivisions per semitone)
Handle variable cycle lengths for analysis
components.notes: Well-tested, working implementation. Provides the foundation for the entire pipeline.

components.name: Audio Graph Builder
components.description: Converts spectral analyzer output into a NetworkX directed graph with temporal, harmonic, and music theory edges
capabilities: Build nodes from frequency-time-intensity points above threshold
Create temporal edges (same frequency across time)
Create harmonic edges (harmonically-related frequencies)
Calculate edge weights (intensity correlation, harmonic strength)
Generate note names from frequencies
Filter low-intensity nodes
components.notes: Newly created component. Implements core graph construction logic from AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION.md design.

components.name: Harmonic Analyzer
components.description: Uses community detection to identify fundamental frequencies from their harmonics
capabilities: Extract harmonic subgraphs by time sample
Detect harmonic communities using Louvain algorithm
Identify fundamental frequency in each community
Calculate confidence scores for fundamentals
Filter noise based on intensity, confidence, duration
Generate timeline of detected notes
components.notes: Newly created component. Implements harmonic filtering from AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION.md design.

components.name: Onset Detector
components.description: Detects note onsets using temporal flow analysis on the audio graph
capabilities: Calculate intensity derivatives across temporal edges
Detect sudden intensity increases (onsets)
Distinguish onsets from sustained notes
Use betweenness centrality for transition detection
Verify onsets across harmonic communities
Estimate note durations
components.notes: Needs to be implemented. Design specified in AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION.md.

components.name: MIDI Generator
components.description: Converts detected notes and timings to MIDI file format
capabilities: Create MIDI files from note events
Set tempo and time signature
Add note on/off events with velocity
Support multi-track MIDI (for instrument separation)
Quantize note timings to musical values
Add metadata (key signature, etc.)
components.notes: Needs to be implemented. Should use mido library for MIDI file generation.

components.name: Audio-to-MIDI Pipeline
components.description: Main orchestrator that coordinates all components to transcribe audio to MIDI
capabilities: Accept WAV file input via CLI
Orchestrate full pipeline: spectral analysis → graph → analysis → MIDI
Provide progress feedback
Handle errors and edge cases
Support configuration options (intensity threshold, confidence, etc.)
Output MIDI file
components.notes: Main entry point. Needs to be implemented to tie all components together.

components.name: Audio Format Converter
components.description: Utility for converting audio files to WAV format for processing
capabilities: Convert between audio formats using ffmpeg
Resample audio to target sample rate
Extract audio from SF2 soundfonts
components.notes: Optional preprocessing utility. Can convert MP3/FLAC/etc to WAV before analysis.

components.name: MIDI File Parser
components.description: Parses existing MIDI files for validation and comparison
capabilities: Parse MIDI files into structured dictionaries
Extract note events and program changes
Handle percussion channels
Provide timing information
components.notes: Could be used to validate generated MIDI by comparing against ground truth.

excluded_components.name: reco.py
excluded_components.reason: Audio synthesis from MIDI (reverse direction from our pipeline). Not needed for audio-to-MIDI transcription.

excluded_components.name: convert_tool.py
excluded_components.reason: Appears to be a thin wrapper around convert_audio.py. Redundant.
